notes.text: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi, or simply al-Khwarizmi was a mathematician active during the Islamic Golden Age, who produced Arabic-language works in mathematics, astronomy, and geography.
Al-Khwarizmi is remembered as a scientist connected with Central Asia, Abbasid Caliphate.
Al-Khwarizmi's recorded life dates place this profile around c. 780-c. 850.
Al-Khwarizmi is grouped with Science, Math & Technology in the People Library.
Al-Khwarizmi's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Central Asia, Abbasid Caliphate historical setting.
